name: engineering-academy
description: Engineering courses with video lectures, plus a personal training system: capture what you learn, then explain it, rebuild it, and verify it. Installable on iPhone as a PWA.

scripts.build: node scripts/sw-version.js --check && node scripts/bundle-static.js --check && node scripts/check.js
scripts.test: node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --test tests/api.test.js tests/learning.test.js tests/courses.test.js tests/brand.test.js tests/deploy.test.js tests/curriculum.test.js
scripts.cloud:deploy: node scripts/sw-version.js && node scripts/bundle-static.js && node scripts/check.js && wrangler deploy
